scope: 12 frozen development tasks only; metadata projection. No prompts, arguments, source text, outputs, patches or model reasoning copied. Not training data.
methodology: Only raw-wire request->response/error intervals count API wall time. model_request/model_response and ADK usage are not added to wire usage.
Interval unions within each task remove overlaps from concurrent background model requests; sums across distinct tasks retain task-weighted denominator.

At timeout an unreturned CancelledError request is right-censored at agent_end bounds: final capture epoch through fresh_judge phase epoch. Context elapsed is the monotonic denominator; no fabricated clock offset.

Tool start/end use capture outer timestamps paired by function_call/response ID. ADK event.timestamp on assistant events predates generation and is not tool start. These durations include dispatch/capture overhead.
API completion_tokens are observed numeric totals only. Missing usage for cancelled requests is unknown, not zero. No text-to-token estimate and no inferred reasoning token count.
API wall time includes queueing/prefill/generation/transport; it is not isolated GPU decode or measured thinking time.

interpretation.observed_bottleneck: At six session timeouts, model API request intervals cover 99.7756%-99.7906% of summed Agent elapsed time; run_command intervals sum to 2.946 seconds and other tools to 0.115 seconds across those six tasks. All six terminate with an unreturned model request, not an in-flight tool.
interpretation.token_limits: 217 observed wire responses across all dev: 205 tool_calls, 12 stop, zero length. 66958 observed completion_tokens exclude unknown generation on six cancelled requests. No numeric reasoning_tokens are reported.
interpretation.decision: A separate single low-thinking-budget Agent arm is worth an exploratory comparison because the visible time bottleneck is model API waiting rather than tool execution. This does not establish that reasoning alone caused latency: queueing/prefill/transport are included and there is no first-token trace or reasoning-token usage. A lower budget may trade repair accuracy for latency.
interpretation.comparison_scope: Keep the base/LoRA main A/B at the same existing 4096 thinking_token_budget and all other Agent/service settings. If authorized and budgeted later, compare a single explicit lower-budget setting (for example 1024) on the complete same 12dev as an independent mechanism arm; do not rerun only failed cases or attribute that result to LoRA.
